name: Timemore Chestnut C3
details: Hand grinder; clicks counted from the start point (dial turned fully clockwise). Timemore advises not to grind at the finest 0–6 clicks.

rangeInfo.note: Timemore C2/C3 manual (multilingual, hosted by a retailer), table for C3/C3 Max: espresso 7–8 clicks, pour over 13–16, French press 17–20. “For your reference only.”
